name: Supply Chain X-ray
tagline: A read-only X-ray of a sales, purchase, production, transfer or return order, and a batch trace: every stage at a glance, and why it is stuck.

permissions.sidePanel: Shows Supply Chain X-ray in the browser's side panel, next to D365.
permissions.storage: Your settings only: the thresholds per order type, the Follow D365 switch, and per D365 environment the table ids that charges need. No order data.
